target_customer: Educators, corporate training and marketing teams, and creators who need narrated whiteboard explainer videos from documents or prompts
problem: Explainer videos are costly and slow to produce; general video models make short cinematic clips that struggle with technical accuracy. Golpo generates narrated, animated whiteboard videos from a prompt or document.
business_model: Freemium SaaS with credit tiers (Creator $99.99/month per HN thread) plus enterprise API

founders.name: Shreyas Kar
founders.background_notes: Brother of Shraman; press gives ages 20 (Shreyas) in Oct 2025.

founders.name: Shraman Kar
founders.background_notes: Age 19 in Oct 2025 per press; age at founding not stated.

competitors.name: Google NotebookLM
competitors.what: Video overviews from documents (static slides per commenter)

technical_complexity.rationale: Orchestrates LLM planning, narration, time-aligned animation and editing; commenters guessed it combines image generation with SVG animation, so mostly integration engineering.

defensibility.rationale: One HN commenter claimed they could replicate it quickly and Google ships adjacent features; no data or network moat shown.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: By the August 2025 launch, a commenter noted NotebookLM already produced videos from documents; no acquisition reported.

market_need_then: Press cites school districts, corporate training, sales decks and internal comms using it; no figures. Launch HN had 116 points and 46 comments.

branding.name_origin: A founder said on the Launch HN thread that the name comes from the Bengali word for story.
branding.domain_note: Product at video.golpoai.com (golpoai.com), not an exact .com match.

identity.visual_style: White-on-black whiteboard animation in a Khan Academy / RSA Animate style (some commenters disliked it)
identity.voice_and_tone: Commenters praised narration tone and voice

branding.brand_signature: Whiteboard explainer videos in RSA Animate style
branding.community_and_virality: Launch HN (Aug 2025): 116 points; users shared generated videos. One commenter noted resemblance to the SMBC 'Gulpo' comic.

brand_strength.rationale: Meaningful story name and an HN hit with a clear niche, but no mascot, merch or independent brand press; early days.

outcome_analysis: Golpo, founded by two Stanford-dropout brothers, launched on HN in August 2025 and announced an oversubscribed $4.1M seed led by BNVT Capital in October 2025, with Golpo 2.0 in February 2026. It rides the generative-video wave and targets a niche that cinematic models serve poorly, but Google ships adjacent features and no revenue or retention is public, so it is too early to call.
notes: Seed $4.1M seen in Pulse2 (2025-10-26), Martech Series and others; a second source reports Golpo 2.0 press release dated 2026-02-23 alongside the seed news. Neuronfeed lists an extra $500K YC seed in 2025-01 (unverified, not recorded); StartupHub's '$500M' is an obvious error. Founded 2024 per YC vs 2025 per press. Ages are from Oct 2025 press, so age_at_founding left null. HN timestamps were relative only; August 2025 comes from a mirror snippet. Whiteboard-video incumbents (Doodly, VideoScribe) were not tied to dated sources so are omitted. Confidence high because founders, competitors and funding are all sourced.
